intent.instructions: Which of these options would this particular pigeon most likely do next, given its personality, needs, mood and surroundings described in `pigeon` and `situation`?

criteria.wander_taskbar: Stroll along the taskbar without a goal.
criteria.explore_new_window: Walk over to the window that opened a minute ago and inspect it.
criteria.observe_cursor: Sit and watch the cursor move.
criteria.perch_window_top: Perch on the top edge of the active window.
criteria.seek_attention_user: Walk near the cursor and coo to get the user's attention.
